## What's new in 0.3.7

- **Fixed:** a crash at launch ("did not then call startForeground") when the player resumed in the background.
- **Dock:** the dock now really sits higher, with the mini player just above it.
- **Video player menu (⋮):** shorter, with Quality first; Autoplay, Repeat mode, Resize mode and Sleep timer are gone.
- **Accent colours:** Crimson is now a vibrant, saturated **Red** and Sunset orange a vibrant **Orange**.
- **Downloads:** the progress label shows the numbers on one line and MB/GB below, right-aligned with steady digits, so it no longer jumps around.

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/capheproject/BetterTube#changelog).
